```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
```

# Loading the datasets

## Price Data - Dependent Variable

```{r}
# Reading and reformatting
prices <- read.csv("RE_prices.csv", header = TRUE ,sep=";")
prices <- prices %>%
  mutate(quarter=as.character(quarter))

# Subset and pivot efh
efh <- subset(prices, select = c("bez_id", "bez_name", "quarter", "efh_avg"))
efh <- efh %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("bez_id", "bez_name"),
    names_from = quarter,
    values_from = efh_avg,
    names_sort = TRUE
  )

# Subset and pivot etw
etw <- subset(prices, select = c("bez_id", "bez_name", "quarter", "etw_avg"))
etw <- etw %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("bez_id", "bez_name"),
    names_from = quarter,
    values_from = etw_avg,
    names_sort = TRUE
  )

# Subset and pivot gst
gst <- subset(prices, select = c("bez_id", "bez_name", "quarter", "gst"))
gst <- gst %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c("bez_id", "bez_name"),
    names_from = quarter,
    values_from = gst,
    names_sort = TRUE
  )

```
### Data Dictionary - Price Data

```{r}
price_dd <- tibble::tibble(
  Variable = c("bez_id", "bez_name", "efh", "etw", "gst"),
  Type = c("Integer", "Character", rep("Numeric", 3)),
  Definition = c(
    "Identifier for each Austrian political district",
    "Name of each Austrian political district",
    "Average transaction price of single family houses in EUR per m²",
    "Average transaction price of apartments in EUR per m²",
    "Average transaction price of building plots in EUR per m²"
  )
)
kable(price_dd)
```




## Event Data - Interaction Term

```{r}
shock <- read.csv("EAMPD_event.csv", header = TRUE, sep =";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

shock$X.date <- as.Date(gsub('"', "", shock$X.date), format= "%d.%m.%Y")

shock <- subset(
  shock, 
  X.date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
  select = c("X.date", "OIS_20Y", "DE20Y", "DE30Y")
  )

```
## Control Variables - Interaction Term

```{r}
# Building Land
bl <- read.csv("C_bl.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# Household Size
hhsize <- read.csv("C_hhsize.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# Net income with reordering columns
inc <- read.csv("C_inc.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

date_cols <- grep("^X\\d{2}\\.\\d{2}\\.\\d{4}$", names(inc), value = TRUE)

ordered_date_cols <- date_cols[
  order(as.Date(sub("^X", "", date_cols), format = "%d.%m.%Y"))
]

inc <- inc[c(setdiff(names(inc), date_cols), ordered_date_cols)]

# Population
pop <- read.csv("C_pop.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")

# Unemployment
unemp <- read.csv("C_unemp.csv", header = TRUE, sep=";", dec=".", quote = "", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
head(unemp)
```
